en: A sepia-toned historical postcard showing a group of South or Southeast Asian boys and young men, barefoot and dressed in traditional attire, most of them wearing turbans and sarongs. Some are riding donkeys or goats in an enclosure, with European spectators in the background standing behind a fence. In the background, there are trees, a gazebo-like structure, and a palm-thatched shelter. Printed text at the bottom identifies 'Gustav Hagenbeck' and refers to a 'large Indian exhibition' in Dutch. There is also cursive handwriting and a stamp indicating publication from Dresden.
